statement: When workstream or repo policy requireAlignApprove is true, turn close and push/PR/CI (pnpm ledger:align) of product changes require a code-target review with verdict approve bound to treeDigest, coverageSource, and uncoveredPaths=[] (or waiverIds) from an align reviewer (identity prefix distinct from the turn producer), or an explicit align-waiver with minimum reason length; missing artifact fails the gate — silence is not skip. Align findings must not affect verify.ok.
rationale: Cheap align agents write structured JSON approval; builder must not self-approve; hooks and CI enforce. review.schema now admits treeDigest/uncoveredPaths/coverageSource/waiverIds for implementation in SLC-03.
